adc.scope: Predictive conditional charge/settling/decision recurrence, not fitted silicon. receiver.scope: Shared loaded source/input/supply spectrum and 236 mA mode budget. Assigned instantaneous early-gain rail sensitivity; fixed NF/IIP3 and ideal linear filter internals.
